address.description: The IP address or hostname of this endpoint.

isVanityUrl.description: Indicate whether the url in the AwsEndpoint is a vanity url.

clusterId.description: The Id of the C3 cluster where the URL is routed.

cname.description:
The CNAME is a type of resource record in the Aws HostedZone Recordset. The cname
represents the domain where the url will be directed. Either CNAME or ipAddress must be must be provided.

ipAddresses.description:
The IP addresses where the url will be directed. This is used for "A" Record. Either canonicalName or ipAddress
must be provided.

isDnsFailoverSupported.description: Indicate whether it allows to add a DNS failover for re-routing this endpoint in case the site is down.

title:
This type provides a high-level interface to manage the URL under the DNS registry of Amazon Route53. It is using the
underlying AwsHostedZone and AwsHostedZoneRecordSet to perform the actual action.
name: AwsEndpoint
